env.steady_probe_ms_basis: the render loop for each (engine, page) cell runs in its own fresh process against a warm cache: one untimed warm-up render, then runs x iterations-per-run timed renders
env.steady_probe: one fresh process per cell (steady-probe.php); a shared process lets an already-declared class skip both the compile and the cache write, which changes a per-render cache check
env.run_order: no order: each (engine, page) cell is measured in its own process, so measurement order cannot affect a cell
env.first_render_ms_basis: one render in a fresh process with a cold template cache: engine class loading, template compile, cache write and one render
env.first_render_probe: a fresh process with opcache.enable_cli=1 but a per-process CLI segment, so the engine source is compiled in that process; template cache cold
env.base_mem_basis: memory_get_usage(false) with the engine constructed and configured, nothing rendered
env.use1_mem_basis: memory_get_usage(false) after one render in a fresh process, gc_collect_cycles() called first
env.retained_mem_basis: memory_get_usage(false) after a whole run of iterations_per_run renders in a fresh process, gc_collect_cycles() called first
env.peak_mem_basis: memory_get_peak_usage(false) actual bytes over a whole run of iterations_per_run renders in a fresh process
env.opcache_probe: a fresh process with opcache.enable_cli=1 but a per-process CLI segment, so engine source is compiled in that process
